$comment: The one place published names, the engine's Nx project and directory, the NAPI platform rows and the publish switches are declared. Workflows, scripts and tests read this file; rename here and nowhere else.

wasm.$comment: The selected delivery recipe pins Darwin ARM64 host tools (emsdk, nightly rustc), so the WASM build runs on macOS until a Linux recipe exists; moving it is this one runner value.

publish.$comment: npm is on: the trusted-publisher bindings for ci.yml + npm-publish exist (2026-10-13), so every main push publishes a next prerelease. PyPI publishes stable releases only and stays off until the first stable release.
